description: This file defines the EmpUsTaxExemptionController class, which handles the viewing and permission management of US tax exemption data for employees within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It interacts with services, components, and employee data related to tax exemptions.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionController
classes.description: Controller class managing the display and permission settings for employee US tax exemptions, extending BaseViewEmployeeController.

methods.name: getCountryService
methods.description: Returns the CountryService instance used to fetch province data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with employee tax exemption data and permissions before rendering.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups relevant for capability/permission checks.
